svg.title: Access checkpoint
svg.desc: A secure lobby against a plain wall with a lock sign. A metal-detector portal with a traffic light on its post stands on a floor mat. Two flap turnstile pedestals with card readers and LED strips face a lane marked with chevrons; the glass flaps swing open. A fingerprint pillar with a small screen, a guard desk with a camera monitor and chair, a ceiling-mounted camera and a line of stanchions complete the lobby.
